AlienRace.ThingDef_AlienRace.label: Robot «Fabricator» class
AlienRace.ThingDef_AlienRace.description: An advanced robot model for working in a factory. Capable of carrying out construction and mining work, as well as servicing working machines. It has an expanded memory capacity, which allows you to learn more efficiently. This type of robot is equipped with a liquid engine for energy production and is capable of consuming only liquid fuel.
